Its crossings are, by `restrict_mapCrossing_range_iff` (1037-1060) and `restrictCrossingEquiv` (1063-1071), in bijection with exactly the crossings of D both of whose strands lie on components of B — exactly the internal crossings, none dropped, none added (they are determined geometrically, not chosen). Reviewer discrepancies: the Fin q tag shift, the increasing-index reindexing in `restrict`, the absence of a separate field for the "crossing-free disjoint union" sentence, A/B rendered as D_0/D_1, the polygonal-only class, and the vacuous q = 0 case are all real but each is a pure relabelling, a derived special case, or a layer-wide convention shared with the accepted rows; none changes the set of instances or the asserted equation. Nothing printed is unrendered; nothing in Lean is unprinted; no definition means something different when expanded. The statement is a faithful rendering.

Not refuted. I expanded every clause of `StackData` (statement file lines 1350-1359) to primitives and compared it against sm-3:1494-1512; no printed clause is missing, no Lean clause is unprinted, and no definition means something different. Clause by clause:

(a) "actual nonempty diagram ... partitioned into q ≥ 1 nonempty tagged blocks". `D : Diagram` (LinkDiagram.lean 490) has `Γ : Shadow` with `hc : 0 < c` (83-87), so nonempty is built in. `blk : Fin D.Γ.c → Fin q` with `hblk : Function.Surjective blk` (1352): a function from the component set assigns each component exactly one tag, surjectivity makes every fibre nonempty — exactly a partition into q nonempty tagged blocks. q ≥ 1 is forced: for q = 0 no function `Fin c → Fin 0` exists when c ≥ 1, so every inhabited instance has q ≥ 1 and the ℕ-subtraction `q - 1` (1354) is the printed q−1. Tags 0..q−1 vs 1..q is an order isomorphism, and only the order is used.

(b) "at every crossing between different blocks the smaller-index block is under the larger one". `BlockOrdered` (65-67): ∀ x s t, s ∈ x.val → t ∈ x.val → blk s.1 < blk t.1 → D.underStrand x = s. A crossing is a two-element Finset {s,t} of non-adjacent (hence distinct) strands (IsCrossing 246, Crossing 251, crossing_card_two), `s.1 : Fin c` is the component (Strand 96), and `underStrand x = other x (over_mem x)` (505) is the non-over strand. For a mixed crossing exactly one ordered instance has `blk s.1 < blk t.1`, and it forces the smaller-block strand to be the under strand; for an internal crossing `blk s.1 = blk t.1` so every instance is vacuous — "no restriction on crossings inside a block" is rendered by absence, as printed.

The only extra datum is the increasing reindexing of the block's components, an auxiliary order under which P is independent (lp:lm sm-3:942-944); non-blocking.

(d) eq. mp:stack-value: `P D = R.delta ^ (q - 1) * ∏ i : Fin q, P (blockRestrict D blk hblk i)` (1354) with `P` = the accepted lp:core object (LocalPolynomial.lean 22) and `R.delta = (R.a - R.aInv) * R.zInv` (LinkLaurentRing.lean 193) = δ = (a − a⁻¹) z⁻¹ (sm-3:1046).
